content.short: WalletChat is a web3 messaging layer that lets any dApp add wallet-to-wallet messaging for its users in minutes.
content.description: WalletChat is a wallet-to-wallet chat app and a widget that lets dApps add messaging for their users in minutes. The chat uses end-to-end encryption and keeps users on the host site, enabling secure conversations without leaving the application. It integrates with Ethereum, Polygon, Multichain, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Avalanche, and BNB Chain, providing broad chain coverage within a single integration.
content.meta: WalletChat provides a wallet-to-wallet chat app and widget with end-to-end encryption. Discover WalletChat and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
